Forest Communities

You learned the woodland paths by gathering beside your elders and learned its stories by giving each remembered speaker a different voice.

Which tree marks the way home?

Rules

Type: Culture. Status: Proposal. Choose one paired option; do not mix the rank from one with the card from another.

- Wilderness 1 and @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.3ff4bda4da041710.JournalEntryPage.a5571bc8312127b0]{Forage Woodland}. - Mind 1 and @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.ea5defd9130a4ab8.JournalEntryPage.aa87c9479af9f046]{Borrow a Voice}.

Grant at level 0. Duplicate grants provide 1 stage DP each; never promote a rank automatically. No discipline purchases at level 0. Ancestry does not restrict this choice. Follow each card’s explicit equipment grant.

Starting coin contribution: +5 coins. See @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.0558be1f6014ee71.JournalEntryPage.880380bcd80cfec6]{starting coins}.
